shortDefinition: The basic unit of text that AI models process — roughly 3-4 characters or 3/4 of a word.
fullDefinition: Tokens are the chunks of text that LLMs work with. Text is broken into tokens before being fed into the model, and the model generates tokens one at a time. Tokens can be words, parts of words, characters, or punctuation. Approximately 1,000 tokens equals about 750 English words.
examples: Most models allow 8,000 to 128,000 tokens of context
